hook: Michelle Boston is listed by Reuters Events as Chief Information Officer, Data Management Technology and Enterprise Architecture Executive, Bank of America, among the speakers at Momentum AI Finance 2026 in New York. According to Michelle Boston's LinkedIn profile, the post, based in Dallas, began in March 2024, after twelve years as a managing director and data management technology executive at the bank.
